title: Return exactly selected records and factual discovery context
statement: The Command handling Module shall return the explicitly selected current operational information and factual capabilities with coherent scope and availability, without selecting authority or choosing maintenance recovery.

what.problem: Even a valid snapshot becomes misleading if command selection adds inferred records, hides omissions, or presents unavailable content as an empty result.
what.desired_outcome: A caller can distinguish the requested recorded information from excluded, omitted, unavailable, or unobserved information.

why.rationale: SR-041 assigns meaning to explicit selection and discovery; MOD-010 owns those query rules and their public presentation.

stakeholders: Engineers and agents supplying explicit command requests
Maintainers of MOD-010 and its Interface consumers

conditions: A caller requests capabilities, Change context, or a selected Review or Verification.

contexts: IF-004 current query presentation using IF-003 coherent reads and availability facts.

how.approach: Provide explicit scoped current-context and item queries plus project capability inspection through the current CLI, preserving coherent values and truthful limitations.

how_much.scope: Current operational query responsibility; no requirement to scan docs/changes, expose SQL, enumerate the database or preserve the predecessor query grammar.

acceptance_criteria: Admit explicit Change/item queries and optional bounded context selectors; no stage label implicitly broadens selection.
Return full selected meaning and current support, with explicit absent/omitted distinctions; views are derived from one authority.
Unknown, unavailable or malformed content does not become an empty valid record or inferred contract.
Deduplicate and bound declared selectors according to the closed current query contract; no retired cursor/page interface is implied.
Oversized selected accounts fail explicitly rather than truncate rationale or hide unresolved issues.
Capabilities reports actual executable tasks, contract identity and backend standing without scanning legacy directories or choosing authority.
Read operations never author engineering state or choose replacement recovery; SQLite may recover its already determined transaction outcome.
constraints: Current selected task/query contract; predecessor filesystem discovery and field-projection interfaces are retired in the successor.

sources.basis: Derive this draft lower-level obligation from the containing SR at the selected command or operational-record responsibility boundary. Allocation and acceptance criteria are design claims for review, not implementation, requirement approval, or satisfaction evidence.

sources.locator: docs/design/cli/cli.md#CLI-SR-01, CLI-SR-14, CLI-SR-21, CLI-SR-22, CLI-SR-23, CLI-SR-24, CLI-SR-28, CLI-SR-32; docs/design/cli/records.md#RF-SR-02, RF-SR-07
sources.basis: Preserve the applicable current public and stored-record guarantees at this accountable boundary. The named source retains exact schemas, operation tables, classifications, limits, and historical adoption obligations; this allocation neither replaces those details nor accepts REM authoring JSON as operational records.

sources.locator: MOD-010 current task/query contract; MOD-011 typed read boundary
sources.basis: Refines the existing inspection need to the selected successor task interface; no new IR or implementation approval.
